title: jwSpawn
description: A simple and functional spawn plugin!
body:
jwSpawn is a powerful, flexible, and highly customizable spawn point plugin for Paper 1.16.5 – 26.1.2 servers. It provides administrators with complete control over teleportation, while players enjoy a comfortable and beautiful experience.

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 Main Functions

- Setting a spawn point — /spawn set
- Teleporting to spawn — /spawn teleports a player to the spawn with a configurable delay.
- Teleporting other players — /spawn <nickname> teleports the specified player to the spawn (requires permission).
- Teleporting all players — /spawn all instantly teleports all online players to the spawn.
- Deleting a spawn point — /spawn del deletes the spawn point.
- Reloading the config — /jwspawn reload reloads all settings without restarting the server.

### ⏱️ Configurable timer

- Delay before teleportation — configurable in seconds (default 5).
- Cancel on movement — if the player moves, the teleportation is interrupted.
- Cancel on damage — taking damage cancels the teleportation.
- Instant teleportation — set the delay to 0, and /spawn will work without waiting.

### 📢 Timer display (configurable separately)

- Chat — a chat message with a countdown.
- ActionBar — text above the inventory.
- Title — a large title and subtitle that fill the entire screen.
- BossBar — a progress bar at the top of the screen with a customizable color and style.

### 🎵 Sounds

- Timer tick sound — a customizable sound for each second of the countdown.
- Completion sound — a victory sound upon successful teleportation.
- Everything is customizable: sound type, volume, and pitch.

### 🛡️ Permissions (LuckPerms, any managers)

- jwspawn.spawn - Teleport to spawn
- jwspawn.tp - Teleport another player
- jwspawn.tpall - Teleport all players
- jw.spawn.set - Set spawn point
- jwspawn.del - Delete spawn point
- jwspawn.reload - Reload plugin
- jwspawn.group.vip - Group settings for VIPs
- jwspawn.group.admin - Group settings for admins

### 🧬 Group Settings
_You can set different settings for different groups of players:_

- Teleport delay
- Cancel on movement/damage
- BossBar color and style
- Sounds
- Example: VIPs have no delay, admins have no delay and no boss bar.

### 💀 Teleport on death

- Upon death, the player can respawn at the spawn point (enabled in the config).
- The override-bed option ignores beds and respawn anchors.

### 🌍 Localization
_Supported languages: Russian, English._

- The auto mode determines the language of the player's client.
- You can add your own translations to the locales/ folder.

### 🎨 Color support
_HEX colors (<#RRGGBB>Red text</#RRGGBB>)_

- Gradients (<gradient:#RRGGBB:#RRGGBB>Gradient text</gradient>)
- Mini messages (<bold>, <green>, <obfuscated>)
- Legacy codes (&a, &l, &x&R&R&G&G&B&B, §c)
